name: Backlog Comisiones
query:
with
cc_margin as (
  select
    si_cc.cost_center,
    case
      when sum(si_cc.base_net_total) > 0
      then sum(si_cc.base_net_total - coalesce(cogs.total_cogs, 0)) / sum(si_cc.base_net_total)
      else 0
    end as avg_margin_rate
  from `tabSales Invoice` si_cc
  left join (
    select
      gle.voucher_no,
      sum(abs(gle.debit)) as total_cogs
    from `tabGL Entry` gle
    inner join `tabAccount` acc on acc.name = gle.account
    where gle.voucher_type = 'Sales Invoice'
      and gle.docstatus = 1
      and acc.account_type = 'Cost of Goods Sold'
      and gle.debit > 0
    group by gle.voucher_no
  ) cogs on cogs.voucher_no = si_cc.name
  where si_cc.docstatus = 1
    and si_cc.posting_date between ( %(to_date)s - interval 90 day ) and %(to_date)s
    and si_cc.base_net_total > 0
  group by si_cc.cost_center
  having sum(si_cc.base_net_total) > 0
),
rate_cc as (
  select
    cr.cost_center,
    cr.porcentaje_comision
  from `tabComisiones Settings Sucursal` cr
  where cr.parenttype  = 'Comisiones Settings'
    and cr.parent      = 'Comisiones Settings'
    and cr.parentfield = 'tasas_por_sucursal'
),
rate_default as (
  select (s.value + 0.0) as default_rate
  from `tabSingles` s
  where s.doctype='Comisiones Settings' and s.field='porcentaje_sobre_utilidad'
  limit 1
),
cc_root as ( select lft, rgt from `tabCost Center`  where name = %(cost_center)s ),
sp_root as ( select lft, rgt from `tabSales Person` where name = %(sales_person)s ),
base_si as (
  select si.*
  from `tabSales Invoice` si
  inner join `tabCost Center` cc on cc.name = si.cost_center
  where si.docstatus = 1
    and si.posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
    and cc.lft >= (select lft from cc_root) and cc.rgt <= (select rgt from cc_root)
    and exists (
      select 1
      from `tabSales Team` st
      inner join `tabSales Person` sp on sp.name = st.sales_person
      where st.parent = si.name
        and sp.lft >= (select lft from sp_root) and sp.rgt <= (select rgt from sp_root)
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from `tabClientes Sin Comision` ex
      where ex.parenttype  = 'Comisiones Settings'
        and ex.parent      = 'Comisiones Settings'
        and ex.parentfield = 'clientes_sin_comision'
        and ex.customer    = si.customer
        and (ex.start_date is null or si.posting_date >= ex.start_date)
        and (ex.end_date   is null or si.posting_date <= ex.end_date)
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from `tabComision LLCS` c
      inner join `tabOrden de Pago Comisiones` opc on opc.name = c.parent
      where opc.docstatus = 1
        and c.sales_invoice_id = si.name
    )
)
select
  si.name          as "Factura:Link/Sales Invoice:160",
  si.posting_date  as "Fecha:Date:95",
  si.customer      as "Cliente:Link/Customer:220",
  si.cost_center   as "Sucursal:Link/Cost Center:200",
  (si.base_net_total)  as "Venta (OPC def):Currency:120",
  coalesce(m.avg_margin_rate, 0)                    as "Margen pct CC:Percent:110",
  coalesce(r.porcentaje_comision, d.default_rate, 0)    as "Rate Comisión:Percent:110",
  round( (si.base_net_total) * coalesce(m.avg_margin_rate,0) * coalesce(r.porcentaje_comision, d.default_rate, 0) / 100.0, 2) as "Comisión Estimada:Currency:140",
  coalesce(st.sales_person, '') as "Vendedor:Data:150",
  case 
    when exists(
      select 1
      from `tabPayment Entry Reference` per 
      inner join `tabPayment Entry` pe on pe.name = per.parent 
      where per.reference_name = si.name
        and pe.docstatus = 1
    )
    then 'Pagado' else 'Pendiente' 
  end as "Status Pago:Data:100",
  case 
    when exists(
      select 1
      from `tabSales Invoice Item` sii 
      where sii.parent = si.name
        and ifnull(sii.delivery_note,'') != ''
    )
    then 'Entregado' else 'Pendiente'
  end as "Status Entrega:Data:100",
  si.custom_status_comisiones as "Status Comisiones:Data:120"
from base_si si
left join cc_margin    m on m.cost_center = si.cost_center
left join rate_cc      r on r.cost_center = si.cost_center
left join rate_default d on 1=1
left join `tabSales Team` st on st.parent = si.name and st.idx = 1
order by si.posting_date desc, si.name desc
